Daikoukai Jidai II.name: Daikoukai Jidai II
Daikoukai Jidai II.summary: Daikoukai Jidai II (aka Uncharted Waters - New Horizons) is perhaps the most famous of the series. Even though an English version exists, it still has not managed to achieve the mainstream popularity Pirates! had. There is only a relatively small following outside of East Asia.

DeJig - McKnight - Art Collection.name: Dejig: McKnight Art Collection
DeJig - McKnight - Art Collection.summary: Dejig: McKnight Art Collection is a jigsaw game for the Sega Saturn released as part of the Dejig series.

Game no Tatsujin 2.name: Game no Tatsujin 2
Game no Tatsujin 2.summary: Adaptations of popular Japanese board games for Saturn and PlayStation

Gunbird.name: Gunbird
Gunbird.summary: Gunbird uses anime-styled character as the player's chosen craft. A story plays out in between levels and before boss fights, telling a tale of how the protagonists are trying to collect pieces of a magic mirror to make a wish.

HatTrick Hero S.name: Hattrick Hero S
HatTrick Hero S.summary: Soccer game from the Hat Trick Hero series exclusively on Sega Saturn.

Sound Novel Machi.name: Sound Novel: Machi
Sound Novel Machi.summary:
Machi is a story of 8 unrelated protagonists, all with their own problems and objectives, all living in the Shibuya district of Tokyo, Japan. The story spans 5 in-game days and is told through a huge number of live-action still photographs. Each of the protagonists lead a completely different story that even defies genres.

The player must play all of the stories in parallel, jumping across different protagonists, and backtracking to re-select branches which not only affect the active protagonist, but also other protagonists through often bizarre twists of causality.

Yellow Brick Road.name: Yellow Brick Road
Yellow Brick Road.summary: An adventure game based on L. Frank Baum's novel The Wonderful Wizard of Oz.
